summary.name: Pencil2D
summary.one_liner: Pencil2D is an open-source, free 2D animation tool for making hand-drawn animations with raster and vector workflows.
summary.what_it_does: Pencil2D is a tool for making 2D hand-drawn animations. It supports both raster and vector workflows, letting users switch between them to sketch, ink and paint. The page describes it as lightweight and easy to use with a minimal interface. It runs on Windows, macOS, Linux and FreeBSD. The project is open source and free to use, including commercially, according to the page.
notable: Seamless switching between raster and vector workflows
Open source and free, including commercial use
Runs on Windows, macOS, Linux and FreeBSD
caveats: Windows installers are mentioned only in nightly builds on the news list
Page does not state specific feature limits
